about: The narrator's lines. A wildlife documentary voice that watches the job applicant the way a nature film watches a small animal having a very bad day. The voice is the one saved in Brandon's ElevenLabs account under the name in audio.narratorVoice in config/showcase.json.
status: Script of change note 003 (November 27, 2026) with its second and third updates, entered by the Builder as Brandon's words (AGENTS.md: a line of narration Brandon rewrites is replaced with his words). Lines 1 to 6 and line 8 are settled; line 7 is his pick B3, entered as three entries at its own pauses (giving up, the turn, the rise) with no word changed. Line 9 is a draft and is kept apart in content/narration-drafts.json. Every older line and every live-only line is gone, as the note orders: eight spoken moments, everything else silent. Nothing is recorded: no narrator take, no test take and no ElevenLabs credit on narration until Partner brings his word to record. The notes are pasted word for word in kit/PROGRESS.md.

direction.inBrandonsWords: Kind of Australian, National Geographic vibe: talking real slow, with a pause every few words. Somebody narrating what the user is doing in a condescending way, but funny, all of it. Never mean or rude just to be mean and rude. Look at the pitiful applicant as it tries to pay its bills, desperately. More than just wildlife.
direction.hisExample: The lion (pause) walks to the den of his friend (pause) and then (pause) pounces on him.
theFiveThingsItDrawsOn: The pitiful creature: the applicant as a species doing what its kind always does.
Money: rent, bills and loans are why it keeps going.
Company speak, quoted flat by someone who stopped believing it.
Made-up field facts, delivered as science.
The narrator's own opinion: he has watched a thousand of these and is a little bored.
direction.whoTheJokeIsOn: The job hunt and the company. The applicant is the one the audience feels for.
direction.notWanted: A first test voice whispered and sounded sincere. He does not want that. Never whispering, never excited, never cruel. Not constant: it speaks at chosen moments and leaves the rest to the picture and the sound.

rules: The mark / is a pause. It is never spoken. Phase 0 finds what makes this voice pause and replaces the mark with it.
Slow. A line is spoken at no more than audio.narratorMaxWordsPerSecond words a second, pauses included.
Condescending and dry, and always funny first. It pities the applicant. It never insults it for the sake of it.
It says 'the applicant', 'they' and 'their'. Never 'you'. On the live site the applicant is the visitor, and the narrator talks about them as if they could not hear.
It never laughs and never raises its voice.
It never explains a joke the picture already tells.
Not constant. Most beats have no line. Room is left for the sound effects.
Every word is spoken exactly as written. No word is added.
Each film line has a 'live' entry: what the visitor does on the live site that plays the same line there, once.

marketing.stroll.text: Ahh. / Here we have / another job applicant. / Desperately hoping / to pay their rent. / Poor fool. / They must have forgotten / it is 2026.
marketing.stroll.live: the careers page is on screen at its top, as soon as the browser lets the page make sound

step1.firstName.text: The application / has sensed / a candidate. / ATS turrets rise.
step1.firstName.live: the turrets rise at the Name field

step1.shredded.text: The applicant / need not worry / about the shredded resume. / They will have to type it all in / by hand / anyway.
step1.shredded.live: the shredder has finished and the form shows its resume received message

step2.crank.text: The applicant / must turn the volume / all the way up.

step2.crank.live: the crank reaches the top, after a pause

pinball.seal.text: The company / gently collects / the applicant / for an unpaid assessment.

boss.verify.text: They declare themselves human. / The form / takes that as a threat.

boss.unfold.text: The applicant / is ready to give up. / There is no salary listed. / No guarantee / their resume / makes it past the ATS. / Their hand moves / to close the Chrome tab.
boss.unfold.live: the boss has formed and the applicant stops

boss.unfold.text: But then / they remember / their student loans.
boss.unfold.live: straight after the line before it; the boss music starts on the words their student loans

boss.unfold.text: They turn back. / One more round.
boss.unfold.live: straight after the line before it, over the boss music

decision.letter.text: After careful consideration, / the company / has decided / to move forward / with other candidates.
